## Summary
Maintains RTP sender and receiver statistics for LiveKit SFU media paths. The package owns packet counters, loss and duplicate accounting, jitter and RTT tracking, RTCP sender and receiver report conversion, snapshot deltas, protobuf export, and lightweight variants used when full timing state is unnecessary.

## Responsibilities
- Track full and lightweight RTP sender and receiver packet statistics.
- Maintain snapshots and delta windows for reporting intervals.
- Process RTCP sender reports and reception reports for RTT, jitter, loss, propagation delay, and clock skew state.
- Convert statistics into log objects, protobuf RTPStats, RTCP reports, and aggregate or RTX-reconciled results.
